core.title: 96 Inch Offset Security Bar, Pemko 3572SP/96
tags: commercial Steel Door Latch Guard Plates

text.description_html:
96 Inch Offset Security Bar

Pemko's 96" Offset Security Plates are for use on single outswing wood or metal doors to cover the gap between the door and jamb. Protects the full door height (96"), effectively preventing prying and manipulation of the door. Great for side and rear exit doors, specially doors equipped with Panic Devices.

Excellent for school classroom door opening onto exterior walkways and are specified and approved by major school districts for this purpose.

Made from 10 gauge galvanized steel for strength and durability. The very fine matte finish acts like a primer allowing paint to adhere easily and is very rust proof. Includes thru-bolts for mounting.

Specifications for Pemko 3572SP Offset Security Bar
  • Length: 96"
  • Width: 2-1/4"
  • Thickness: 1/8" (0.137)
  • Supplied drilled 12" on center with 1/4" holes
  • Includes thru-bolts for mounting

*Sold Individually
